title: Varner Valley Public Utility District's April to September 2027 irrigation pumping energy, the first season the Varner River watermaster holds the riparian and pre-1914 rights to a quarter of their allotments
subdomain: load forecasting (an irrigation rate class's season energy under a change in its surface water supply, built as acre-feet each pumping plant must move times that plant's own energy per acre-foot)
prompt_shape: one season energy in 5,000 MWh steps; delivery-point energy by billing month; delivery-point demand in each monthly system peak hour; irrigation services and billed energy by delivery point

distractors.why_relevant: the PUD's pump efficiency tests, with each tested plant's head, flow, input and energy per acre-foot
distractors.why_unused: it covers only plants of 75 hp and more, all of them Lone Bench wells, whose 2027 energy the 2022 season already gives; no figure reads it
distractors.ruled_out_by: the dictionary (plants of 75 hp and more) and the register's plant sizes

distractors.why_relevant: the county's 2025 harvested acreage by crop, the crops the class irrigates
distractors.why_unused: it is county-wide acreage and value, with no water or energy; no figure reads it
distractors.ruled_out_by: its own heading (all of Kestrel County) and its columns
